items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 7.1.7(e)–(g) cover locating the supply leak, measuring the affected floor and wall base, and one call-out. Allow about €650 for 14 technician-hours plus €350 for the call-out and specialist testing, without billing the same labour twice.

items.description: Expose, repair and re-insulate sink supply pipe
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(a), (c) and (g) cover access and like-for-like repair of the failed indoor pipe. Allow €140 for access and removal, €190 for replacing the roughly 1.5 m copper section and fittings, and €55 for matching foam lagging.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the plumber's separate invoice. Allow €76 gross for one van attendance, in line with the comparable kitchen leak claim.

items.description: Dry affected kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover drying the areas with confirmed moisture and the final readings. Allow €105 for one condensation dryer for roughly seven days and €85 for setup, collection and final checks; no separate electricity allowance under 7.1.8(d).
